7. [IRET.23.7] **A build without the `regex` capability links no RE2.**
   A target that never loads a regex-using artefact builds against
   a stub source in place of `ds_re2.cc`: the `ds_re2_compile` /
   `ds_re2_match` symbols still resolve, but `ds_re2_compile`
   always returns failure and nothing of RE2 is linked. Such a
   build omits `regex` from the capabilities it reports
   ([LCAP.1]), and refuses a DSC whose `requires` lists `regex`
   with `DS_ERR_DSC_CAPABILITY_ABSENT` before decoding any body
   ([RDSC.16.2.7]).

   This check reads the artefact's `requires`, which the compiler
   computes from content, never its settings, so it refuses a
   regex-carrying DSC whatever its `regex` setting ([LNRE.4.2]).
   Neither this build choice nor its absence changes what a
   pattern means when regex support is present at all — that is
   [IRET.23.1], unaffected.
